title: Studio: a new field's API name derives only on the first label keystroke — typing `Health Score` yields API name `h`
body:
Finding from the promo-video lane (steedos-labs/video-studio#5). Filed as a finding only; not claiming it. Looks like a partial regression of #2260 (closed 2026-07-05), which asked for the API name to follow the label while the field is unsaved.

## Measured (hotcrm `main` @ `5e08628`, `@objectstack/* 17.2.0` console Studio, writable package, Playwright against a local dev server)

- Add field → API name `field_10`, label `New field`.
- **Fill the label in one input event** (`fill("Health Score")`) → API name becomes `health_score`. ✅
- **Type the label character by character** (`pressSequentially`, 60 ms per key, i.e. a person typing) → the first keystroke `H` triggers the one-time derivation, API name becomes **`h`**, and every later keystroke leaves it at `h`. Editing the label again afterwards does not re-derive either.
- So the derivation fires exactly once, on the first label change, and takes whatever the label is at that instant.

## Expected

While the field is new/unsaved, keep syncing the API name from the label on every change (the object/app identifier behaviour), and lock it on first save — the behaviour #2260 describes. A person typing normally should end up with `health_score`, not `h`.

## Why it matters

A user who types the label by hand gets a permanent one-letter column (`h`) that leaks into the REST API, formulas and exports, and nothing on screen tells them the API name stopped following the label after the first character.

Related: the objectstack finding filed alongside (Studio publish does not validate object-level `highlightFields` references), same recon session.
